what: Ventas is a healthcare property owner. It owns senior housing communities, outpatient medical buildings, research centres and hospitals in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom, and operates much of the senior housing itself rather than just collecting rent.
customers: Senior housing residents and their families, healthcare providers renting medical offices, and universities and biotech firms renting research space.
money: communities it operates, taking the resident fees directly
rent from medical offices and research buildings
moat: Senior housing in markets where very little new building has happened since 2020, just as the population most likely to need it is growing fastest.
risks: Debt of about $13 billion against very little cash
Operating senior housing means taking on staffing costs and occupancy risk directly
Research building demand has softened with biotech funding
Reported net margin is low because of depreciation
opportunities: Revenue grew about 18% last year as senior housing occupancy recovered
The number of Americans over 80 grows sharply for the next decade
Almost no new senior housing has been started, so supply stays tight
watch: Senior housing occupancy and the net operating income growth in that portfolio.
